shared_image_key_rule: normalized source route plus occurrence; excludes repeated missing-image.svg fallback placeholders

postprocessing.operation: Offline normalization of captured paths and matching of stable non-placeholder image routes; no browser re-run and no screenshot changes.
postprocessing.reason: The capture stored only the path for the repeated missing-image.svg fallback, so its original ?source= identity was unavailable. Stable source routes were compared separately; the harness file now retains the full source query if reused.

comparison_boundary.placeholder_pairing: The first capture stored path but not the ?source= query, so these repeated fallback nodes are not paired as original source images. They remain fully present in each per-variant raw metric list.
comparison_boundary.other_http_errors: Each variant logged three CSS background.jpg 404s; images themselves were 472/472 complete, with no failed requests and no external requests.

capture_code_provenance.note: The executable was amended after the 3-page capture to normalize source paths and retain query identity; the run was not repeated. This current SHA is not represented as the hash of the executed revision.

interpretation.root_review: Parent review found the no-injection control fully rendered and noted the formal browser harness uses headless:true, while this prototype used headless:false. Do not attribute a difference to CSS compositing or treat the injected variants as product acceptance.
interpretation.observed_metrics: Across 451 stable non-placeholder same-source image routes, both CSS variants had zero rect, visibility, or natural-dimension differences from control. 21 repeated missing-image.svg placeholder nodes were not reliably paired because the original ?source= query was not captured.
interpretation.decision: No compatibility-layer fix inferred; stop this experiment here.
